3532-5078-6822-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

151-2416-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-2416-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-2416-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Rise and Shine.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

2105-5778-7175-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

628-4247-7199.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4636-5770-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating six 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get 12 {E}.
Repeat.

1594-4200-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2334-2724-4006.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Soulherder. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2556-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-5330-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5330-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

277-774-3861.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Orzhov Basilica.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Orzhov Basilica's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-3861.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

339-677-5256-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

851-1409-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4659-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4659-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

3259-6965--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6965--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

2254-3227-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
2254-3227-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Scrivener, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Scrivener's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Scrivener from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1495-3334-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Lae'zel.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-3334-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-4404-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-4404-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Corridor Monitor and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Corridor Monitor and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Corridor Monitor and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Corridor Monitor tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-4404-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Corridor Monitor. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

222-527-2438-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2525-4681-5231.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2556-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2556-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Mnemonic Wall and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1479-1659-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

141-4050-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-4050-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-2757-5006-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2757-5006-5147.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

3183-4050-4191-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lovestruck Beast, adding {G}.
Cast Heart's Desire from your graveyard by paying {G}, creating a 1/1 Human creature token, and then exiling Heart's Desire.
Cast Lovestruck Beast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1708-2011-2060.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Halana and Alena has at least six power.
Opponents can not block and kill Najeela.
1708-2011-2060.description:
Move to combat.
Halana and Alena trigger, putting at least six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Attack with at least Najeela.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Crystaline Crawler by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

541-544-2104-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Sanctum of Eternity by tapping it and paying {2}, returning Venser from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

337-776-1329-2915.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-2915.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Lodestone Bauble to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Lodestone Bauble.
Cast Lodestone Bauble.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
